description: This Go source file generates plugin interface code, including hooks and API method wrappers, for the Mattermost platform. It uses Go AST parsing, templates, and code generation to create RPC client/server code and timer layers for plugin hooks and APIs.

methods.name: FieldListToFuncList
methods.description: Converts an AST FieldList to a string representing a function signature.

methods.name: FieldListToNames
methods.description: Extracts parameter names from an AST FieldList, optionally in variadic form.

methods.name: FieldListToEncodedErrors
methods.description: Generates code to encode error fields in a struct.

methods.name: FieldListDestruct
methods.description: Creates a destructured list of variable names from an AST FieldList.

methods.name: FieldListToRecordSuccess
methods.description: Determines if a field list indicates a successful record (no errors).

methods.name: FieldListToStructList
methods.description: Converts an AST FieldList to a string representing struct fields.

methods.name: baseTypeName
methods.description: Extracts the base type name from an AST expression.

methods.name: goList
methods.description: Runs 'go list' command to get package directory paths.

methods.name: getPluginInfo
methods.description: Parses Go package directory to extract plugin hooks and API interface info.

methods.name: generateHooksGlue
methods.description: Generates RPC client/server glue code for plugin hooks and APIs using templates.

methods.name: generatePluginTimerLayer
methods.description: Generates timer layer code for hooks and APIs for performance metrics.

methods.name: getPluginPackageDir
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin package directory path.

methods.name: removeExcluded
methods.description: Removes specified hook/API functions from plugin interface info based on exclusion list.
